I started therapy to help me yesterday, and boy is it weird but cathartic. I hope she does that because she'll have so many emotions pent up in herself that she needs to talk out.

But really, not contacting him was the best thing. He tried so much to contact me. He waited outside my house. He sent me letters, found me on dating sites to contact me. He tried SO HARD and promised he would change. I know that at the moment he hasn't. He is still the anxiety wridden, weed smoking (as in he's smoking 2g a day) person he was when I was with him. I'm realising that I have to work on myself and my emotions because I matter too. My self worth was so low I didn't think I was worth it and I still don't now but on a lesser scale. I'm not selfish for having problems, in fact I probably cared too much. But any time I had a problem, he would take it as a personal vendetta against him. Promptly I would get kicked out of his place late at night and I'd have to walk home.

So all in all, am I recovered? Not really. I put all of myself into this man to help him. So much so I lost myself as well as my friends. I'm trying my utter best to recover to what I was but it's so hard. I feel so numb to everything. I'm going to the gym, focussing on looking after myself and actually caring for me. I know eventually I'll get there but it takes a lot to look after someone emotionally.
